recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，散布大量體積巨大、細胞質豐富、核呈多葉深染或鹿角狀（staghorn）的巨核細胞，單個或鬆散成群分布，這種大型成熟巨核細胞增生是原發性血小板增多症（ET）的骨髓線索；本圖整體細胞密度偏高，需結合臨床排除 PV 或早期 PMF。
features: Markedly increased megakaryocytes, many large to giant with abundant mature eosinophilic cytoplasm
Hyperlobulated, deeply lobated ('staghorn') hyperchromatic megakaryocyte nuclei
Megakaryocytes dispersed singly and in loose clusters, including paratrabecular and perisinusoidal locations
Hypercellular background with granulocytic and erythroid precursors and extravasated red cells
Scattered fat spaces and a bony trabecula at upper left; no obvious fibrosis on H&E
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a marked increase in megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are predominantly large to giant with abundant mature cytoplasm and hyperlobulated, staghorn-like nuclei, arranged singly and in loose clusters. Granulocytic and erythroid elements are present in the background, and no overt fibrosis is appreciated on H&E. Reticulin stain and correlation with JAK2/CALR/MPL status and blood counts are needed; in the context of thrombocytosis, findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as essential thrombocythemia, although the overall hypercellularity warrants exclusion of prefibrotic primary myelofibrosis and polycythemia vera.

ddx.vs: PMF shows hypercellular marrow with granulocytic proliferation and dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, whereas ET megakaryocytes are large and mature with staghorn nuclei in a normocellular marrow.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size and elevated hemoglobin, rather than an isolated increase in giant megakaryocytes.
Reactive megakaryocytic hyperplasia shows normal-sized, normally lobated megakaryocytes without clustering or giant forms.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity shows ring sideroblasts on iron stain and dyserythropoiesis in addition to ET-like megakaryocytes.
